intro: Dalaran Pendants are magical talismans carried by the Kirin Tor wizards stationed at the village of Ambermill in Silverpine Forest. The Forsaken seek to collect these pendants to disrupt the magi's arcane workings and trace the source of their power.

p: In the village of Ambermill, Kirin Tor sorcerers, conjurers, and protectors actively weave formidable arcane spells threatening Forsaken control over southern Silverpine Forest. Each operative carries an attuned Dalaran Pendant. At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister tasks Forsaken operatives with recovering these pendants to slow down the mages' efforts and uncover who is guiding their magical weave.
